sources.summary: Every tool you give an agent sends its definition to the model on every request, and you pay for it as input tokens. A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server can add tens of thousands of tokens to the context window. The usual alternatives are a command-line tool (CLI) or a skill.

items.title: 安全公司 Claroc：94.7% 的 Grok 构建应用可被任意访问，含患者数据和 SpaceXSI 内部文件 / Grok-built apps exposed patient data, plaintext passwords, and SpaceXSI's own sales pipeline

sources.title: 安全公司 Claroc：94.7% 的 Grok 构建应用可被任意访问，含患者数据和 SpaceXSI 内部文件 / Grok-built apps exposed patient data, plaintext passwords, and SpaceXSI's own sales pipeline
sources.title_zh: 安全公司 Claroc：94.7% 的 Grok 构建应用可被任意访问，含患者数据和 SpaceXSI 内部文件
sources.title_en: Grok-built apps exposed patient data, plaintext passwords, and SpaceXSI's own sales pipeline
sources.title_original: Grok-built apps exposed patient data, plaintext passwords, and SpaceXSI's own sales pipeline
sources.summary: 安全公司 Claroc 报告称，在检查的 37,571 个仍在线的 Grok 构建应用中，35,578 个（94.7%）无需登录即可访问，原因是发布对话框默认预选"Anyone with the link"，且每个应用的独立子域名会进入可检索的 passive DNS 数据库。
